name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Granddaddy Purple
description:
A California classic with deep purple hues and a
grape-candy aroma, Granddaddy Purple is an
indica-dominant strain bred from Big Bud and
Purple Urkle. Its effects are soothing and
sedative, wrapping the body in relaxation while
quieting the mind with a dreamy calm.
Why It Belongs in Chronicles:
In the story of modern cannabis, Granddaddy
Purple is a royal chapter. Loved for its vibrant
color, nostalgic sweetness, and iconic
couchlock, it bridges legacy and luxury. For
Chronicles, GDP isn’t just a strain — it’s a
reminder of where we’ve been and how far
flavor, effect, and culture have come.
